name: Medellín (El Poblado, Laureles), Colombia

visa.notes: Retirement visa requires ~$750/mo pension income (3x minimum wage). Renewable annually. Colombia also offers a digital nomad visa.

rent.notes: ColombiaMove 2026 unfurnished 2BR: Laureles 2.7-3.5M COP, El Poblado 5M+, admin not included; Mitula 3BR listings 3.8-5.5M COP; ICI/Numbeo May 3BR centre $1,288 at 3,780. Typical ~3.8M COP plus ~0.4M admin. USD at ~3,200 COP/USD (TRM early Nov 2026).

healthcare.notes: Full health-coverage cost for 2 resident retirees age 60: EPS contributory affiliation (~12.5% of declared income, roughly $60-150 each in source at 4,050 COP) plus prepagada top-up (Colsanitas/Sura/Coomeva, $80-200 each depending on age, upper end at 60); converted at the stronger peso. Absorbs the old-template health figure previously stored under insurance. Anti-VEGF/GLP-1 notes from stored record still apply.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

healthcare.system: EPS public system; excellent private hospitals. Medellín is a medical tourism hub with top-rated clinics.
healthcare.waitTimes: Short at private hospitals; moderate at EPS

pros: Spring-like climate year-round ('City of Eternal Spring')
World-class healthcare at fraction of US cost

cons.text: Expat reputation issues in some areas (El Poblado)
Language barrier—Spanish essential outside expat zones
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country

taxes.notes: No tax on foreign-source income if not a tax resident (under 183 days). If tax resident, worldwide income is taxed at progressive rates up to 39%.
